title: Referral of Stones to Outside Laboratories under Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services
content:
# Referral Note: Stones Sent to Outside Laboratories

**Where the stone goes.** Where a service of Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services sends a stone to an outside laboratory, it goes only to one of the laboratories that service accepts, and it travels under insurance at the services that insure it. Which laboratories a service accepts, and whether the stone travels insured, are fixed per service.

**Who bears the laboratory's fee.** The laboratory's fee is passed on to the customer at the services that pass it through and absorbed at the services that do not.

**What the fee is charged against.** A laboratory fee is charged only against the piece it was incurred for, identified by the laboratory and the merchandise line sent out. The pairing of laboratory and merchandise line on the engagement's records is what authorises the charge, and it is read before the fee is priced; a laboratory fee that cannot be matched to a laboratory and a merchandise line sent out under that engagement is not charged.

**Mounted stones.** A stone in a mounting is sent out only where the mounting may safely be opened, and where it may not the report states the stone as it sits and says so.

**Whose opinion stands.** A laboratory's grading, once returned, stands over the counter opinion taken at intake.

## Conditions in one view

| Situation | Treatment |
|---|---|
| The service sends stones out and the laboratory is one the service accepts | the stone is sent to that laboratory |
| The service sends stones out and the laboratory is not one the service accepts | the stone is not sent to that laboratory |
| The service passes the laboratory fee through | the fee is charged to the customer, against the piece it was incurred for |
| The service does not pass the laboratory fee through | the fee is absorbed by the chain |
| The mounting may safely be opened | the stone is sent out |
| The mounting may not safely be opened | the stone is reported as it sits, and the report says so |
| The laboratory's grading has returned and differs from the counter opinion | the laboratory's grading stands |

## Questions answered

**Two stones on one engagement went to the same laboratory; which piece is each fee charged against?** Each laboratory fee is charged against the piece it was incurred for, identified by the laboratory together with the merchandise line sent out, so the two fees sit against two different merchandise lines.

**The counter opinion at intake graded a stone higher than the laboratory later did. Which grade does the report carry?** The laboratory's grading, once returned, stands over the counter opinion taken at intake.
